name: ADS1115
full_name: Texas Instruments ADS1115 16-Bit, 860-SPS, 4-Channel Delta-Sigma ADC with PGA, Oscillator, VREF, Comparator and I2C
description: The ADS1115 is a 16-bit delta-sigma ADC with an integrated programmable gain amplifier (PGA), voltage reference, oscillator, and I2C interface. It provides 4 single-ended or 2 differential inputs at data rates up to 860 samples per second. The PGA scales the full-scale range from +/-256 mV up to +/-6.144 V, making it ideal for measuring small sensor signals without external amplification. A standout trait is the on-chip programmable comparator with the ALERT/RDY pin, which can flag threshold crossings or signal conversion-ready without polling. It is the de facto hobbyist and lab choice for adding precision analog inputs over I2C.

pins.name: ADDR
pins.description: I2C target address select; tie to GND/VDD/SDA/SCL to pick one of four addresses

pins.name: ALERT/RDY
pins.description: Comparator output or conversion-ready; open-drain, needs pullup to VDD

pins.name: VDD
pins.description: Power supply; decouple with 0.1 uF to GND

pins.name: SDA
pins.description: I2C serial data; needs pullup to VDD

pins.name: SCL
pins.description: I2C serial clock input; needs pullup to VDD

typical_application: Reading multiple precision analog sensors (thermistors, potentiometers, low-level bridge outputs) into a microcontroller over I2C.
gotchas: ADDR pin sets the I2C address by which rail it ties to: GND=0x48, VDD=0x49, SDA=0x4A, SCL=0x4B, giving up to four devices per bus
ALERT/RDY is open-drain and exists only on the ADS1114/ADS1115; it requires an external pullup
Absolute input voltage on any AIN must stay within GND-0.3 V to VDD+0.3 V even when the PGA range is small
The plain ADS1113 has no comparator or ALERT/RDY pin; do not assume code written for the 1115 maps to it
Internal reference and oscillator are fixed; full-scale is set by the PGA, not by an external VREF pin
